name: Burning Manticore (CR 3)
body:
Burning Manticore
CR 3

Type burning
Notice Perception DC 20; hp 6
Trigger proximity; Reset automatic (24 hours)

EFFECT

Atk +8 touch (burning stinger against one target in area B2, 4d6 fire damage); Reflex DC 15 to avoid catching on fire (these flames burn only the haunted target, and cannot spread to other creatures or objects)
